```{r}
## synthetic data evaluation: gaussian covariates 
set.seed(999)
P <- 3
Q <- 2
N <- 500
  
B_true <- matrix(c(0.7, -0.4, 0.2,  0.5, -0.6,  0.3), nrow = P, byrow = TRUE)
S0_true <- matrix(c(1.0, 0.2, 0.1, 0.2, 0.8, 0.15, 0.1, 0.15, 0.9), nrow = P, byrow = TRUE)
Sigma_hat <- cr_build(fit, sim$X, return_array = TRUE)
  
sim <- cr_synthetic(N = N, B = B_true, S0 = S0_true, seed = 101)
  
fit <- zero_mean_covreg_em(W = sim$W, X = sim$X, init = "adaptive", max_iter = 500,
    tol = 1e-8, verbose = FALSE) 

sigma <- cr_build(sim)
sigma_hat <- cr_build(fit, X_new = sim$X)

cov_array_mse(sigma_hat, sigma)
```

```{r}
## synthetic data evaluation: stationary AR covariates 
N <- 500
Q_ar <- 2

phi   <- c(0.85, 0.60)
sigma <- c(0.4, 0.7)

X_ar <- sapply(1:Q_ar, function(j) arima.sim(n = N, model = list(ar = phi[j]), sd = sigma[j]))
X_ar <- as.matrix(X_ar)
X <- X_ar

stationary_sim <- cr_synthetic(N = N, B = B_true, S0 = S0_true, X = X, seed = 123)
stationary_fit <- zero_mean_covreg_em(W = stationary_sim$W, X = stationary_sim$X, init = "adaptive", max_iter = 500,
    tol = 1e-8, verbose = FALSE) 

sigma_stationary <- cr_build(stationary_sim)
sigma_hat_stationary <- cr_build(stationary_fit, X_new = X)

cov_array_mse(sigma_stationary, sigma_hat_stationary)

stationary_fit$S0 - S0_true
```
